hints.text: Work out the power of ten first. Dividing by it makes the number smaller, so think about which way the decimal point moves.
$10^2 = 100$, so move the decimal point two places to the left. The whole number $85$ has its point at the end, like $85.0$.
The point moves from $85$ to $8.5$ and then to $0.85$, so $85 \div 10^2 = 0.85$.

explanation: The power $10^2$ equals $100$, so dividing by it shifts the decimal point two places to the left.
Write $85$ as $85.0$ to see the point. One shift gives $8.5$ and a second shift gives $0.85$.
So $85 \div 10^2 = 0.85$, which is the same as $85$ hundredths.
